## Data pages
- [Music Catalog Deal Tracker 2019–2026: Public Deals and Prices](https://spacemusic.io/data/music-catalog-deals/): 52 publicly reported music catalog acquisitions with buyer, seller, rights sold, reported price and source, plus multiples stated by catalog buyers.
- [Streaming Platform Catalog Sizes 2026: Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer and More](https://spacemusic.io/data/streaming-platform-catalog-sizes/): How many songs are on Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, Deezer, TIDAL, SoundCloud, Qobuz and Pandora, as each platform states it, with sources.
- [Deezer Prices 2026 by Country: Premium, Duo, Family and Student](https://spacemusic.io/streaming-rates/deezer-prices-2026/): Deezer subscription prices in 10 countries, checked on Deezer's own offers pages in September 2026, with links.
